title: RFE team to Argentina

description:
Rotary Club | District 3141, India
Rotary Club of Rojas | District 4895, Argentina
*President: David Costanzi | *Secretary: Andrea Lopez

As part of the Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026–27, the delegation of Rotary Club, District 3141, attended a warm and engaging Rotary meeting with Rotary Club of Rojas, District 4895, Argentina.

They had invited interact club for attending the meeting.

Interacts gave power point presentation of their projects to RFE team. We have donated $ 500 for their projects

Dr. Kamalini Pathak, India Team Leader, addressed the gathering and shared her thoughts on the RFE experience and the strong bonds being created between the two Rotary Districts.

A special Flag Exchange Ceremony was organised.

Two Districts, Two Countries, One Rotary Family.

A truly enriching Rotary meeting that celebrated culture, fellowship, international understanding and friendships that transcend borders.
